title: Service target port
description:
Write a v1 Service named web selecting app=web, exposing TCP port 80 to targetPort 8080. Default ClusterIP is sufficient.

STATIC LAB: YAML is parsed and listed fields are checked. Docker/HCL/shell are bounded authored text checks, not real tools. Passing is not a deployability or security guarantee.

reference.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
      protocol: TCP

hints: What must exist before the next operation can work?
Which field links this resource to the thing it controls?
What observation would prove readiness rather than just existence?
editorial: Service port and targetPort live on different sides of the forwarding abstraction. An incorrect selector yields no endpoints even with correct port numbers.
